text: This report requests Council approval to permit cafés and public space installations to continually remain on a portion of King Street from Bathurst Street to Jarvis Street, as shown in Attachment 1, and on a portion of Duncan Street south of Richmond Street West, as shown in Attachment 2, until April 14, 2023, subject to annual permitting. Under existing authorities, the curb lanes occupied by cafés and parklets are closed to vehicular traffic until December 31, 2019 on Duncan Street and until April 14, 2020 on King Street. This includes seeking authority to extend the temporary closure to vehicular traffic of the portions of King Street until April 14, 2023.
